clips.title: The story
paras: The Call of Earth is a sacred shamanic rite that binds an initiate's mortal spirit to the enduring foundations of the world. By imbibing the visionary brew known as Earth Sapta at a secluded mountain Spirit Stone, the seeker learns humility, patience, and elemental awareness amid the snow and rock.

The Call of Earth is a sacred trial of spiritual attunement, requiring an initiate to drink the enchanted brew known as Earth Sapta at an isolated mountain shrine. Forged through ancient elemental magic, sapta binds the drinker's spirit to the bedrock of the world, granting mortal eyes the rare power to witness elemental spirits and subtle currents invisible to ordinary sight. Because of its potency, the draught must only be consumed in a designated holy site where the bond between spirit and stone can safely take hold.

High up a snow-swept mountain, tucked away at the terminus of a secluded hidden path, rests the Spirit Stone. Initiates journey into this bitter, frozen landscape to stand humbly before the ancient rock. By presenting themselves without pride and imbibing the sapta, they discover that even in the harshest winter crags, the living earth extends its welcome. The mountains become a foundation of enduring physical strength, while the vast, steady plains teach the quiet power of patience.

Communing with stone serves as a foundational rite for spiritual pathfinders. Unlike the restless fury of wind, fire, or crashing water, the earth teaches unmoving discipline and quiet resilience. To pass the rite, the seeker must absorb the earth's quiet essence, preparing their mind and body for the conflicting, chaotic dualities of the more volatile elements that roar across the world.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few adventurer know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.
Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... See what the earth has to show ye.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah... Friend... The earth welcomes you, even in this frozen land. Bound in body and spirit, you'll walk forward knowing the mountains are your strength, the plains your patience, and the world your essence.
To pass this rite, stand humbly before the earth. The other elements are not so still--they clash and roar. Learn their dual nature, even here among the snow and stone.
